children: Mentice AB (STO: MNTC) invites investors, analysts and media to a webcast presentation of its Interim Report for the third quarter of 2026 on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 10:00 CET (Stockholm time).

CEO Frans Venker and CFO Rick van Veen will present Mentice financial performance, key developments during the quarter and the company’s strategic priorities. A moderated Q&A session will follow the presentation, giving participants the opportunity to ask questions.
To join the webcast please register here: DNB Carnegie online registration
A recording of the webcast will be available on Mentice’s investor website after the presentation.

Mentice (STO: MNTC) is the world leader in proficiency based simulation solutions for image guided therapies. Our solutions help healthcare professionals acquire, retain, and enhance their procedural skills driving improved productivity and outcomes. Mentice solutions are scientifically validated and have been specifically developed for healthcare providers and the medical device industry. Neurovascular, cardiovascular, and peripheral interventions are just some of the clinical areas covered by our solutions. Learn more about the features and benefits of Mentice solutions at: www.mentice.com
